Class CashTransaction

java.lang.Object
app.order.execution.CashTransaction
@Entity public class CashTransaction extends Object
One append-only cash movement (BR-09/14/15). accounts.cash_balance is cached from and must reconcile against this ledger — never write the cached balance without also inserting the matching row here in the same transaction.
